{{Removed|date = 2nd of April 2023}} {{ModifierInfobox |image1 = TranslatedModIcon.png |affects = Dialogue |active_in = All matches on the 1st of April 2023 |sandbox = No |rewards_increase = None }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Questionable translations.|In-Game Description}} }} ==Description== '''Translated''' was a cosmetic [[Modifiers|modifier]] that changed the dialogue of [[Narrators]], specifically the [[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]]. '''Translated''' was active on all maps on the 1st of April 2023 as an April Fools' joke, with it being disabled on the 2nd of April 2023. ==Effects== '''Translated''' changed the dialogue of the [[Narrators]]. It translated the dialogue to different languages, then translated it back to English. This resulted in the dialogue being humorously off. In some cases, the dialogue did not translate back to English, either partially or fully. Not all dialogue was changed. '''Translated''' had no other effect on gameplay. ==Dialogue== This does not include lose dialogue, as it was not changed.
